title: Early microliths in Sri Lanka
summary: Tiny stone blades appear at Fa-Hien Lena Cave, the earliest known microlith assemblage in South Asia.
why: Small replaceable parts: an early modular tool design.

notes.problem: Overclaim: source study says 'earliest microlith assemblage in South Asia'; Pinnacle Point (South Africa) microliths date to ~71,000 years (Brown et al. 2012, Nature, doi:10.1038/nature11660). Source also has microliths in Magdalenian Europe, contradicting 'only in the early Holocene'.
